question: Rome mainly grew and flourished because of:
solution:
The correct answer is 'Trade'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about all the myths and legends associated with the founding of Rome. 
 
• In the **third paragraph** of the passage, it has been stated - *'Originally a small town on the banks of the Tiber, Rome grew in size and strength, early on, through trade.' *
 
• Thus, we can conclude that Rome mainly grew and flourished because of **trade. **
 
• This makes **option 2 **the correct answer.
